items.title: Howard Alden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: who I knew that Tal Farlow had played with him

ctx.x: Did it get to a point where — let me rephrase — did you eventually leave California to find a job, or did you leave California because you had a job?

Well I left California, the first time I left the west coast I was called by, of all people, Red Norvo, the great vibes player, who at that time was just a distant idol of mine who I knew that Tal Farlow had played with him, and my first guitar teacher, Jimmy Wyble had played with him for a long time too. And all of a sudden I got this call. I was actually teaching at this Guitar Institute of Technology, a couple of years later, during the day. He said, “Howard, this is Red Norvo.” And I said, “Yeah.” So anyway,…
Like, can you mention a couple of things?
